card.name: Nouns completing a descriptive phrase
card.fires_on: A general noun such as size, color, form, age or degrees that follows an adjective or quantifier (appropriate, yellow, any, advanced, varying). It marks the end of a short modifier phrase.

modes.label: Size after adjective
modes.description: The word size follows an adjective describing equipment such as a syringe or tube.
modes.example: with an appropriate<< size>> oral dosing syringe with graduations

modes.label: Color after a color word
modes.description: The word color follows a color adjective like yellow.
modes.example: Linezolid injection may exhibit a yellow<< color>> that can intensify over time

modes.label: Abstract noun after quantifier
modes.description: Form, age, degrees or shades follow words like any, advanced, varying or different.
modes.example: with varying<< degrees>> of abnormal behavior
